targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, service_name, avg(request_rate) AS request_rate FROM aiopslab.gold_service_window_v2_latest WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND request_rate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time, service_name ORDER BY time

SELECT window_start AS time, service_name, avg(latency_p95_ms) AS latency_p95_ms FROM aiopslab.gold_service_window_v2_latest WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND latency_p95_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time, service_name ORDER BY time

SELECT minute AS time, avg(metric_coverage) AS metrics, avg(log_coverage) AS logs, avg(trace_coverage) AS traces FROM aiopslab.signal_coverage_v2 WHERE $__timeFilter(minute) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT g.window_start, g.run_id, g.service_name, r.condition, r.fault_type, g.log_error_count, g.error_span_count, g.late_event_count, g.duplicate_event_count FROM aiopslab.gold_service_window_v2_latest AS g LEFT JOIN aiopslab.evaluation_reference_v1 AS r ON g.run_id = r.run_id AND g.window_start >= r.window_start AND g.window_start < coalesce(r.window_end, now64(3)) WHERE $__timeFilter(g.window_start) ORDER BY g.window_start DESC LIMIT 200
